description: MA Lighting grandMA3 onPC v2.4.2.2 — full show control software running via Wine. Connects to grandMA3 consoles and processing units over MA-Net3.
notes:
Requires Docker Run Config Override: {"network_mode": "host", "user": "root"} — host networking is mandatory for MA-Net3 multicast console discovery (UDP 8700). Art-Net on UDP 8000, sACN on UDP 5568. GrandMA3 onPC launches automatically on desktop open.

1.19 fallback uses KasmOS desktop because the original custom image is not currently present/publicly pullable. Replace with the native custom image once published.

go.cmd: bash -c "WINEPREFIX=/home/kasm-user/.wine wine '/home/kasm-user/.wine/drive_c/Program Files/MA Lighting Technologies/grandMA3 onPC/grandMA3 onPC.exe'"
